about.title: Art and science, built on a quarter-century of trust.
about.lead: Asaleeb Plus is a leading Riyadh-headquartered architecture and interior design company, serving clients across Saudi Arabia and beyond.
about.body: For over twenty-five years, we have practiced architecture as both discipline and craft — engineering studies grounded in experience, development and innovation. Our work spans residential, commercial and cultural projects, each shaped by the belief that Saudi identity and contemporary design are not in tension, but in dialogue. As a proud contributor to Saudi Vision 2030, the Kingdom builds toward its future — and we build alongside it.

aboutPage.title: A quarter-century of building with intent.
aboutPage.lead: Asaleeb Plus began in Riyadh with a simple premise: that architecture in Saudi Arabia deserved a company fluent in both its heritage and its future.
aboutPage.storyP1: Founded in 1999 by Nasser Al-Mutawa, Asaleeb Plus started as a small interior design practice serving Riyadh families who wanted their homes to feel considered, not decorated. Within a decade, it had grown into a full-scale architecture company with a dedicated head office in Al-Olaya, under the joint leadership of Yazeed Al-Mutawa.
aboutPage.storyP2: Today the company moves fluidly between residential villas, commercial towers, cultural institutions and the furniture that finishes them — a multidisciplinary team under one roof, always guided by the conviction that Saudi identity and contemporary design are not opposites, but collaborators.
aboutPage.mission: To design spaces that hold their value — architecturally, culturally and financially — for the people who commission them.
aboutPage.vision: To be the company Saudi Arabia turns to when a project must be unmistakably ours and unmistakably world-class — and a proud contributor to the ambitions of Saudi Vision 2030.
